decision.overall_recommendation: VIX gate is open, so new entries are technically permitted, but this system's own track record is weak right now (11.7% win rate, avg return -2.9% over 60 tracked picks) — treat that as a real signal, not noise, and size conservatively / consider paper-testing rather than pressing full size even on the cleanest setups below. Of the 32 candidates reviewed, 9 (RMBS, INOD, ENPH, TJX, HGV, LEVI, COCO, IRM, ARQT) were still actively falling (probing lows, no higher low, steep recent returns) and excluded outright regardless of fundamentals. Three more (WULF, ECHO, AKR) were dropped for a combination of deteriorating fundamentals (WULF's widening losses despite a real Anthropic catalyst; ECHO's distorted financials plus 'overbought/crash risk' commentary) or unacceptable trade geometry (AKR's RR of ~1). No ticker in this batch had an earnings-imminent/upcoming tier, so no earnings-catalyst overrides were needed. Given the essentially flat CatalystRecency data (items_last_7d=0 across the board), no pick qualifies as having a genuinely fresh catalyst — nearly every pick's catalyst_status is 'none,' meaning these are technical/fundamental bounces, not news-driven trades; several (CRUS, LBRT, ALGT) also carry active analyst target cuts (TargetsBeingCut) even where earnings beats continue, which is a real headwind worth weighing against the clean charts. CRUS adds to existing Technology sector concentration (INTC already held).

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Revenue is shrinking sharply (-49%, -35% the last two quarters) but EPS is tracking close to estimates and net losses are narrowing; analysts have been raising targets recently (targetRevisionRecentPct +28%) and News shows a genuine positive catalyst (positive Phase 3 lonvo-z data reducing HAE attack rates), even if not within the last 7 days per CatalystRecency.
ranked_picks.rationale: Best overall combination in this pool: a confirmed higher-low base, positive analyst target revisions, and a real (if slightly dated) clinical catalyst rather than a purely technical bounce.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Revenue is contracting quickly and the company remains deeply unprofitable; the thesis leans on binary clinical-stage news that can reverse fast, and the 'Buy' consensus sits on a weak overallScore of 2.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Growth has been volatile (two beats, two narrow misses over the last four quarters) but recently positive (Q2 FY26 revenue +15.8%, net income +40%); the dominant catalyst was the now-terminated $14.5B Element Solutions merger, with shares rallying on the termination as it removed integration/dilution overhang.
ranked_picks.rationale: Strong reversal signals (higher low +10.3%, down/up volume ratio of just 0.24) plus a genuinely material, market-moving news event, even though it isn't fresh by the recency counter.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The range-contraction ratio (1.76) shows the stock is still 'wild,' not settled, and with zero analyst targets set in the last month there's no independent confirmation the market has re-rated it post-merger-termination.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Cirrus Logic has beaten EPS estimates in all 8 of the last 8 reported quarters and carries an A+ analyst rating, but the most recent quarter decelerated sharply (revenue +2.5%, net income -6%) after an outsized prior quarter, and analysts have been cutting targets recently (-9.4% on 2 analysts). News is generic sector commentary with no CRUS-specific catalyst.
ranked_picks.rationale: Elite beat record and rating support inclusion despite an unconfirmed base and active target cuts; ranked below confirmed-support names with cleaner revision trends.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Analysts are actively marking down targets right now despite the beat streak, growth decelerated hard from the prior quarter, and technically the base isn't yet confirmed (no higher low).

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Tapestry has beaten EPS estimates in all 8 of the last 8 quarters, but its latest print combined a beat with soft FY27 guidance (Kate Spade recovery 'taking longer'), which knocked shares down despite strong Coach growth; net income growth has been volatile quarter to quarter (+153%, -39%, +104%).
ranked_picks.rationale: Exceptional beat record and strong Buy consensus (30 buy/11 hold) offset guidance softness, though the base isn't yet confirmed.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The stock sold off on its own guidance despite beating estimates — a sign forward growth concerns, not the beat record, are driving sentiment, and Kate Spade's turnaround remains unresolved.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: The New York Times has beaten EPS estimates in all 8 of the last 8 quarters with generally positive underlying growth; News is mostly macro/market commentary with no NYT-specific catalyst, and analysts trimmed targets modestly (-5.1%, below the cut threshold).
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed base (strong +6.2% higher low, both 10d/20d returns positive) and a very clean beat record support a solid rank despite thin news flow.
ranked_picks.bear_case: RRRatio is below the weak threshold (2.52) and there's no fresh catalyst — the reversal has to stand entirely on the technical pattern and beat history.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: DT Midstream's growth has been modestly positive across recent quarters, though it just missed its latest EPS estimate slightly (1.09 vs 1.17) after two prior beats; News notes a fresh analyst upgrade this week, though a single-analyst target cut (-8.5%) is also on record.
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed higher low, favorable volume behavior, and a recent analyst upgrade make this a reasonably solid, defensive midstream pick.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Liberty Energy has beaten EPS estimates in 4 of the last 5 quarters with accelerating profitability (Q2 FY26 net income +91%, EPS +86%), and News mentions a strategic SLB data-center power alliance; however analysts have been cutting price targets hard (-15.2% on 2 analysts).
ranked_picks.rationale: Genuinely improving fundamentals and a confirmed base support inclusion, but active target cuts and thinner volume support underneath (price above POC) keep it mid-pack.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Analysts are cutting targets meaningfully right now even as fundamentals improve, and the stock sits notably above its point of control, meaning thinner volume-based support if the bounce fails.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Westlake's most recent quarter beat estimates (2.01 vs 1.83) with net income growth of +253%, a marked improvement after several loss-making quarters; News is limited to a routine analyst-target mention with no company-specific catalyst.
ranked_picks.rationale: Genuine fundamental improvement plus a confirmed technical base, tempered by a Hold-heavy analyst split.
ranked_picks.bear_case: One strong quarter follows multiple loss-making quarters, so the turnaround isn't yet confirmed, and Hold-heavy coverage (19 holds vs 8 buys) reflects limited conviction.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Miami International Holdings has beaten EPS estimates in all 5 quarters reported since its 2025 IPO with positive revenue growth each period; there is no News coverage at all for this name.
ranked_picks.rationale: A clean beat record and confirmed base earn a mid-pack rank, but this is the textbook 'clean technical setup with no catalyst' case the screener is known to over-favor.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Zero News flow and zero recent analyst target-setting activity mean there's nothing to independently confirm continued momentum beyond the beat history, and it's a very young public company with a Hold-leaning split.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Smithfield Foods has beaten EPS estimates in 4 straight quarters and carries an A analyst rating with meaningful upside to its $31.50 average target; Cramer flagged it positively and News lists it as an oversold value name.
ranked_picks.rationale: Consistent beats and a positive fundamental/sentiment mix support inclusion despite a below-threshold RR.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Recent quarterly revenue/net-income growth has actually turned slightly negative (-3.5%/-2.9%) even as EPS beats continue, and RRRatio of 2.65 is weak.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: CenterPoint Energy shows a mixed beat/miss record with generally modest, positive underlying growth; News is limited to a generic 'oversold utilities' mention with no CNP-specific catalyst.
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed base and stable utility profile earn inclusion, but it's a purely mean-reversion trade with a weak RR.
ranked_picks.bear_case: No genuine catalyst is driving this beyond the technical pattern, and RRRatio of 2.5 is below the weak threshold.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: People Inc. (formerly IAC) shows extremely noisy EPS swings (large one-time gains/losses distort the trend) and thin recent analyst coverage (only 1 target set last month); News is limited to an earnings-call transcript mention.
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed base and favorable volume behavior support a modest rank, but the fundamental picture is too noisy to weight heavily.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The EPS history is too distorted by one-time items to read a clean trend, and with only 1 analyst setting a target recently, the 'Buy' consensus is a weak signal.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Chemours beat 2 of its last 5 quarters and missed 3; more concerning, net income growth collapsed -844% in the most recent quarter even as revenue grew +15.2%. News is essentially empty.
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed technical base and clean RR keep it in the list, but the sharp recent profitability collapse is a real fundamental concern that caps the rank.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The net-income collapse in the latest quarter is a genuine red flag a clean technical bounce doesn't address, and Hold-rated coverage reflects limited conviction.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Ormat has beaten EPS estimates in 6 of its last 7 quarters, but the most recent quarter showed a sharp revenue/net-income decline (-35.9%/-38.5%) after a strong prior quarter; News is thin with no ORA-specific catalyst.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Alliant Energy has beaten EPS estimates in 6 of its last 8 quarters with seasonal but generally solid utility earnings; there is no News coverage at all for this name.
ranked_picks.rationale: Reasonable beat record and low-beta stability, but a completely catalyst-free, still-forming setup ranks it mid-lower.
ranked_picks.bear_case: A totally catalyst-free, low-beta utility — the case rests entirely on the technical bounce and beat history with no independent confirmation of continued momentum.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Allegiant has beaten EPS estimates in most recent quarters (2.19 vs 1.11 last quarter) but net income growth collapsed -111% in the same period despite +28.8% revenue growth, and analysts have been cutting targets (-12.2%, 2 analysts). News is bullish airline-sector commentary (BofA turning bullish on fares), not ALGT-specific.
